source: SME Corp Malaysia, Guideline on SME Definition (March 2024)
rule: A business is classified by sales turnover OR full-time employees, whichever is LOWER. Must be registered with SSM (or equivalent) and not a subsidiary of a public-listed company, MNC or GLC.

services_and_other.note: Includes F&B, retail, distributive trade, hotels and restaurants, professional/ICT services, agriculture, construction

algorithm: sector_group = 'manufacturing' if sector is Manufacturing else 'services_and_other'
category_by_sales = first of micro/small/medium whose sales limit the turnover satisfies
category_by_employees = first of micro/small/medium whose employee limit the headcount satisfies
category = the SMALLER of the two (micro < small < medium)
if turnover and employees both exceed medium limits -> not an SME
